name: Hearth: Period Tracker Calendar
tagline: A private period tracker you buy once — no account, no subscription, and your data stays on your iPhone.
storage_summary: Your periods, symptoms, moods and notes are stored only on your iPhone. Hearth has no account and no server, and it never sends your data anywhere.
nothing_sent_detail: Data leaves your iPhone only when **you** choose to share it, for example when you export a summary for your doctor or create a backup file and send it with the share sheet. Purchases are handled by Apple through the App Store; we never see your payment details.
stored_on_device: The periods you log (start and end dates, flow), and your symptoms, moods and notes.
Your cycle settings (cycle and period length), reminder choices and app preferences.
Cycle predictions, which are calculated on your iPhone from your own history.
Whether you have unlocked the full version, checked on your device with Apple's StoreKit.
Delete everything at any time with **Settings → Privacy & Data → Delete All Data**.
not_collected: Your name, email address or any account, because Hearth has no sign-in.
Your cycle, symptom and mood logs, which never leave your iPhone unless you export them yourself.
Your advertising identifier (IDFA), location, contacts or browsing history.
Analytics or crash reports, because the app includes no analytics, advertising or crash-reporting SDK.
Payment details, because purchases are processed by Apple.

permissions.name: Face ID / Touch ID
permissions.why: to lock the app, only if you turn on the app lock. The check happens on your iPhone; Hearth never receives your biometric data.

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.why: to remind you before your next period or to log your day, only if you turn reminders on. Reminders are scheduled on your iPhone and are worded discreetly.

your_controls: **Delete all your data** in **Settings → Privacy & Data → Delete All Data**, or by deleting the app.
**Export your data** for your doctor as a one-page PDF or a CSV file in **Settings → Privacy & Data**.
**Turn off reminders or the Face ID lock** in the app, or revoke Notifications or Face ID access in iOS Settings.

support_faq.q: Is Hearth a form of contraception?
support_faq.a: No. Predictions are for reference only. They are not medical advice and not a method of contraception. Talk to a doctor about anything that concerns your health.

support_faq.q: Do I need an account? Where is my data?
support_faq.a: No account is needed. Everything you log is stored only on your iPhone. Hearth has no server, so we cannot see, recover or delete your data for you.

support_faq.q: I bought the full version. How do I get it on a new iPhone?
support_faq.a: The full version is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. Open **Settings → Unlock full version** and tap **Restore Purchases** while signed in with the same Apple Account you used to buy.

support_faq.q: How do I move my data to a new iPhone?
support_faq.a: Create a backup file in **Settings → Privacy & Data → Backup & Restore**, save it (for example to Files or with AirDrop), then on the new iPhone open the same screen and restore from that file. Creating a backup is part of the full version; restoring is free.

support_faq.q: How do I get a refund?
support_faq.a: Refunds are handled by Apple. Request one at [reportaproblem.apple.com](https://reportaproblem.apple.com).

support_faq.q: How do I delete my data?
support_faq.a: Use **Settings → Privacy & Data → Delete All Data** in the app, or delete the app. Your data lives only on your iPhone, so this removes it completely.
